# FLX-3607: the SQL of a consumer query or view is not a usable text

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The sql of a query or a view is a non-empty string of at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes that holds no NUL character. Whether it is a query the engine will run is decided when it is parsed.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3607
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
